boundaries.roles: Eight function roles: label,colors,valueFormat,borderColor,dotSize,dotColor,dotBorderWidth,dotBorderColor. No layerComponent prop.
boundaries.order: Each layer: all original source sample format calls; areaGenerator; label then color on same object with only id,path; propagate label/color. Area border expression separately receives full enhanced layer even width0/fillOpacity0. Dots per sample: size,color,width,borderColor, even size0/alpha0/noninteractive.
boundaries.formatter: Exactly source sample count; no extra area summary formatter call. None is not in public Nivo StreamDatum; runtime-null observation separately records formatter receiving null unchanged.
boundaries.gates: Area component gated by layers entry; dots gated by dots entry and enableDots. isInteractive only affects default area handlers, not function eligibility. Rust hidden and nullable inputs are extensions requiring explicit policies.
boundaries.glyph: Original circle size is diameter. Rust shared GlyphOptions area/nominal size must use explicit precedence/rejection if combined with a dotSize function.
boundaries.runtime: Function passthrough identity assertions are actual original helper branches. Hook/stack/path/spring probes are explicitly authored, not React or d3 implementation emulation.
